issues.explanation: Conventions require a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased], but the diff updates only the three task-listed docs.
Issuance throttle (30/min) is implemented in routes/api.php but no test asserts its 429 rate_limited behavior, unlike pairing throttle.

conventions.evidence: Reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket (channel totem), no service layers; #[Fillable] matches Queue.php; migrations have reversible down(); audit via Log::channel('audit') without full code; docs api/totem.md + architecture.md + database-schema.md updated. Deviation: CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] not updated.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (context/resolveQueue/forbidden, apply/isAllowedOrigin, issue/decode/encode, queue()), clear names, PHPDoc on public methods, sibling style, no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php: format 400 invalid_code_format, lockForUpdate transaction, identical 401 invalid_pairing_code, 200 token/token_type/expires_in/entity.slug+name; app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php: 401 invalid_token + last_seen_at + intersection JWT queues x preset join; TotemQueueController.php: entity 403 forbidden, queue_not_found 404 within-entity only, out-of-scope 403, inactive_queue 422, invalid_priority 422 no create, IssueTicket channel totem 201 A001/A002 ISO-8601; routes/api.php: throttle:10,1 + throttle:30,1 with api/* 429 rate_limited; TotemJwt HS256 with totem_id/entity_id/preset_id/queues/iat/exp/jti + services.totem config + .env.example + phpunit.xml; TotemCors localhost/127.0.0.1 + TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN, 204 preflight, no ACAO otherwise; migrations totems/totem_presets/totem_preset_queue composite PK cascade; entity_suspended never sent.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: PairingCodeCommand, TotemAuthController, TotemQueueController, AuthenticateTotem, TotemCors, Totem/TotemPreset models + Entity/Queue relations, TicketPriority/TotemJwt/TotemPresentation, factories, 3 migrations, routes/api.php, bootstrap/app.php, config/services.php, .env.example, phpunit.xml, 3 docs, TotemApiTest. No unrelated refactors or features.

security.evidence: No weakness found: middleware checks bearer/signature/alg HS256/exp/iat/jti/active/entity-agreement via hash_equals -> 401; pairing returns identical 401 (no oracle) and never logs full code; strict /^\d{6}$/D + integerClaim /D; mass-assignment via #[Fillable] + internal forceFill; CORS strict allow-list + Vary: Origin, no credentials; throttle renders 429 rate_limited with headers.

simplicity.evidence: Lean: ticket issuance delegates to IssueTicket, priorities share TicketPriority::options()/fromRequest single source, minimal dependency-free TotemJwt HS256 (allowed by task), TotemPresentation palette default + appearance override only; no service/repository layers or duplication.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Totem/TotemApiTest.php: malformed codes 400, pairing success + claims/row/consumed, identical 401 x4 (unknown/expired/consumed/inactive), pairing throttle 429, token variants x6 401, scoped active ordered queues with visual.order, intersection take-effect, backend priorities 0/10/20, inactive_queue x2, sequential A001/A002 channel totem, invalid priorities no-create, entity leak 404/403, CORS allow/deny, artisan success/fail, attach/detach. Gap: no ticket 30/min throttle test.

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF contract: pairing command + JWT auth, scope-intersecting middleware, three scoped endpoints via IssueTicket, strict CORS/throttling, and synced docs. Thorough Pest coverage and clean conventions with only nits (missing CHANGELOG entry, no ticket-throttle test), so approve with nits.
